core_obligations: Part (1): essential surjectivity transfers immediately from property (2) for siblings.
Part (2): reduce to a sibling of the identity on D^b(A); prove full faithfulness by extending Hom isomorphisms from A to all of D^b(A).

Ext induction: q=0 by assumption, q=1 injectivity and surjectivity via distinguished triangles of extensions and the sibling isomorphisms, q>1 injectivity via the split criterion and surjectivity via Yoneda composition.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the identity-sibling case via the H = F^{-1} circ F^prime factorization.
Run the Ext induction case by case; each case is fully displayed in-span.
difficulty_reason: Multi-case Ext induction (q=0,1,>1, injective and surjective) with Yoneda extension decomposition and a split-triangle finish; all displayed.
